name: NDA Request Clauses
description: An NDA request form whose Word template prints a clause only when it applies: the mutual-disclosure clause for a Mutual NDA, the one-way clause otherwise (Conditional / EndConditional merge tags around each paragraph). Proven live 2026-10-31.
template: This Non-Disclosure Agreement is made between Fontara, Inc. and {{Counterparty Legal Name}}, effective {{Effective Date}}, for this purpose: {{Purpose}}.

template.text: Mutual disclosure. Each party may disclose Confidential Information to the other, and each protects what it receives.
One-way disclosure. Only the Disclosing Party discloses Confidential Information, and only the Receiving Party protects it.
